    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    from collections import defaultdict
    # build maps
    node_by_id = {}
    parent_to_children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node['id']
        node_by_id[nid] = node
        parent = node.get('parent')
        if parent is not None:
            parent_to_children.setdefault(parent, []).append(nid)
    # validation

        raise ValueError("Must have exactly one root.")

            raise ValueError(f"Parent {parent} not found.")
    all_symbols = {node['symbol'] for node in nodes}
    for sym in required_symbols:
        if sym not in all_symbols:
            raise ValueError(f"Required symbol {sym} not present.")
    retained_ids = {node['id'] for node in nodes}
    symbol_count = defaultdict(int)
    for node in nodes:
        symbol_count[node['symbol']] += 1
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda x: (-x['depth'], x['id']))

        # remove

        retained_ids.remove(nid)
        removed_order.append(nid)
